title: Loose thread
description: One thread, five loops, drawn and drawn out again.
alt: A thin peach thread loops across the square from left to right, rests, then disappears from the end where it began.
note: Naming the curve (a trochoid) gets a far more natural line than asking for something organic. The first envelope left small hooks at both ends; squaring the sine removed them. Review caught the text promising six loops where the curve shows five. A later pass made the loop rest on a faint trace instead of an empty square.
author: Maria Roszyk
